model-execution.title: Model & execution allowance
model-execution.intro: Choose a model revision actually registered by this worker. Preview fixes the configuration; start checks it again.
model-execution.fixed_tool: This tool configures its own model and does not support independent platform selection.
model-execution.empty: No models are available from this worker. Check its local allowlist and recent inventory.
model-execution.steps_hint: 1–{{max}} steps, according to the current tool capability.
model-execution.output_hint: Total output allowance for this run: 1–{{max}} tokens.
model-execution.unpriced: Cost is unpriced; it is not displayed as free.
model-execution.budget_hint: Reservation conservatively uses the declared context bound and maximum calls. This is not a vendor billing guarantee.
model-execution.optional: Leave blank to use organization and project policies.
model-execution.price_first: First configure an operator rate matching this model revision.
model-execution.policy: Organization/project budgets still apply. Missing usage retains the reservation for reconciliation.
model-execution.boundary: These are registration and authorization facts, not service health, model quality or vendor acceptance.
model-execution.invalid_parameters: Enter supported positive integer allowances and a valid budget.
model-execution.invalid_options: Model options do not match the current project or tool. Refresh them.
model-execution.parameters: At most {{steps}} calls · {{output}} output tokens in total
model-execution.reservation: Conservative input reservation {{input}} · output reservation {{output}} tokens
model-execution.select_after_tool: After choosing the tool, configure its model and allowance explicitly.
model-execution.codex_not_supported: This entry does not support Codex execution. Select a supported native repair tool.
model-execution.setup_deployments: Configure models and credential references in the Runner model_deployments allowlist. Native coding and Octop share task model revision, parameter and budget selection; Go retains and uses provider credentials without forwarding them to the coding process.
